messages.content: Where are you traveling? Give me a start and an end, or list up to six cities and I will order the stops. For example: Delhi to Jaipur, or Delhi, Jaipur, Udaipur.
What date do you want to start? You can name a date, say a day either side is fine, or leave the dates flexible.
What is your bus budget per person, in rupees?
What kind of bus do you want?
How do you like the days on the ground? Tell me the pace (relaxed or packed) and what you care about: heritage, food, nature, shopping.
Anything I should avoid? Early departures, long layovers, non-AC buses — or nothing.

Here is what I will optimize for: Mumbai → Goa, starting 2026-11-07, bus budget ₹8,000, AC no seat preference, priority fastest, relaxed pace, interests heritage, food, avoid nothing in particular.
